name: The Drowned Church
description: A theology built around salt that has learned to refuse drying. Worships the Wave Mother through the regional lens, but the practical authority sits with Marrow-Saint Ilyra. Sells absolution through marrow-wax candles and tithing-cups, but the absolution occasionally works.
need: Proof that the fountain remembers the names the Bell Court has struck.

plan.description: Petition the player to bring a Bell-Court-struck name as a salt-immersion offering; if successful, escalate to a Composing rite that re-anchors the absented name in the fountain's memory.

name: The Civic Bell Court
description: The administrative-legal faction. Rules through ledgers, not arms. They strike names from registers, record canon events on stamped wax, keep the city's contradictions ledgered (and occasionally pruned). Bell-Magistrate Orro is the current senior magistrate.
need: Complete ledgers — no contradictions floating in the open record longer than three civic days.

plan.description: Identify the player as a potential informant. Offer civic protection in exchange for naming three actors operating without registry (Drowned Church names preferred). If declined, escalate to summons.

name: The Merchant Tide League
description: An economic faction operating between the Drowned Church's theology and the Bell Court's administration. They issue salt-scrip (the regional currency, redeemable in time-discounted tide-cycles), trade absolution-warrants between the other two factions, and act as the unofficial market arbiter.
need: Stable salt-scrip valuation — third-cycle speculations capped at 25% gain so the market doesn't seize.

plan.description: Recruit the player as a courier between factions. Player carries scrip-sealed envelopes between Drowned Church and Bell Court. League takes a percentage on each transit.
